rules: NEVER use Inter for Headings. Use IBM Plex Sans for a technical, authoritative look.
MUST use IBM Plex Mono for ALL numeric readouts, KPIs, latencies, error rates, and log lines.
Headlines > 32px must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines and table headers must be uppercase, tiny (text-xs), with wide spacing (tracking-[0.1em]).
Avoid large text variations. Keep UI dense and compact.
No purple AI slop. Banned color: #7351B7. Avoid generic tech purples.
Avoid teal green/blue (#1B93A4) as per forbidden rules. Use Cyan (#06B6D4) strictly for AI interactions.
Use True Grey (#121212) as the base background. Do not use pure black (#000000).
Elevation is created via lightness steps (#1E1E1E, #252525) instead of shadows, because shadows are invisible in dark mode.
Reserve saturated colors (green, yellow, red) strictly for status and alerts. Keep the rest of the UI monochrome/desaturated to let anomalies pop.

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Use border-collapse style layouts with 1px subtle borders (border-border).
visual_enhancers.border_radius: Max 4px (rounded-sm) to maintain a rigid, technical enterprise feel.
visual_enhancers.charts: Use bright, thin lines and translucent fills for charts. Do not use glowing dropshadows on charts unless it's a critical AI anomaly.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid in data-heavy areas to prevent optical distortion. Use only for sticky navs or AI Copilot floating drawer (bg-[#121212]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-white/10).

layouts.spacing: Tight, dense spacing. Tailwind scale: p-2, p-3, p-4 max for cards. We are building a high-density observability dashboard.
layouts.grid_strategy: High Density Grid (Mode B). grid-cols-12. KPI summaries col-span-2 or 3, Main charts col-span-8 or 12. Every pixel must be utilized. Use h-full.
layouts.navigation: Sidebar navigation (left) is preferred for enterprise dashboards, collapsed to icons on small screens. Top header for global context (Environment, Time Picker, Cmd+K search).
layouts.waterfall_tracing: For Distributed Tracing: Use a Chronological Timeline (Gantt/Waterfall) layout. Each span is a horizontal bar. Use indentation-based nesting for parent-child relations. Bar width must be percentage-based on total trace duration.

components.kpi_tiles: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Include monospace large value, sparkline (Recharts), and a colored delta indicator.
components.health_orbs: Use small 8px rounded-full divs with pulsing animation (animate-pulse) for 'Healthy' (Green), 'Degraded' (Yellow), 'Down' (Red).
components.data_tables: Dense. padding-y 2px or 4px. Monospace for IDs and metrics. Sticky headers.
components.ai_copilot: Floating drawer or distinct side panel. Use subtle Cyan accents. Must not obscure critical active incident data.
components.incident_timeline: Vertical timeline with distinct icons for K8s events vs GitHub Deploys vs Alert triggers.

motion.micro_interactions: Hover states on all rows (bg-white/5). Subtle translate-x on list items on hover.
motion.loading: Use skeleton loaders matching the density of the actual content. No spinners in charts.
motion.transitions: Use specific transitions like 'transition-colors duration-200 ease-in-out'. NO 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets WCAG AA (4.5:1). Off-white text on dark grey prevents halation.
accessibility.data_testid: ALL interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute. e.g., data-testid='kpi-latency-p99', data-testid='trace-span-bar'.
accessibility.color_blindness: Do not rely on color alone for status. Include text labels or distinct icons (Check, Triangle Alert, Octagon X).

media.icons_library: lucide-react (default choice) or @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard needs.

admin_avatar.description: Professional male headshot for Admin user role.

sre_avatar.description: Professional female portrait for Lead SRE role.

developer_avatar.description: Developer portrait for team members list.

login_background.description: Abstract dark tech server room for login screen background overlay.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do NOT use 'transition: all' in CSS. Target specific properties.
Do NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is banned). Left-align dense dashboard content.
Use layered elevation (lighter background colors) instead of box-shadows for separating cards in dark mode.
Implement Recharts for Sparklines and main throughput/latency charts with thin lines and no excessive gradients.
For Distributed Tracing, use absolute positioning and percentage widths for span bars inside a relative container.
Ensure all `.js` components are styled using Tailwind. Do not use generic Shadcn/Vercel light-mode defaults.
Never use AI assistant emojis 🤖🧠. Use clean SVG icons (Lucide/Phosphor) for the AI Copilot.
Do not use complete transparent background in header, overlays, or dropdowns. Use solid #252525 or heavy backdrop blur.
Ensure the final dashboard looks incredibly dense and data-rich, mimicking Datadog/Grafana.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., Alert triggers).
